scene_delta.title: Surprise Shower Greeting
scene_delta.pose: Standing in a walk-in shower, arms spread wide in an inviting, welcoming gesture, body angled slightly toward the camera as if greeting someone entering the room.
scene_delta.expression: A bright, joyful smile of surprise and recognition, eyes warm and crinkling with delight, reflecting a happy reunion.
scene_delta.outfit: A large, plush white cotton bath towel wrapped securely around her torso and hips, covering her from chest to mid-thigh.
scene_delta.camera: Medium shot, framing from the mid-thigh up to the top of her head to capture the arm gesture and facial expression.
scene_delta.lens: 50mm prime lens, shallow depth of field to softly blur the shower background.
scene_delta.lighting: Soft, diffused overhead bathroom light filtered through steam, creating a warm, intimate atmosphere with gentle highlights on wet skin.
scene_delta.location: A modern, luxurious walk-in shower with marble walls, a rainfall showerhead, and light steam in the air.
scene_delta.action: She is mid-motion, reaching out to welcome a friend, with water droplets glistening on her shoulders and face.
scene_delta.styling: Long dark hair is wet and slicked back, skin is glistening with water droplets and natural texture, minimal natural makeup.
scene_delta.negative_constraints: No other people visible in frame, no airbrushed or plastic skin texture, no exaggerated body proportions, no nudity in the description, no heavy makeup.
